sources.excerpt: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. For fiscal 2025 we plan gross capital purchases of USD 12 billion: USD 9 billion for wafer-fabrication equipment and USD 3 billion for factory construction. These are planned gross purchases before subtracting grants or partner reimbursements. This is our complete guidance for these categories.

SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. We are revising our fiscal 2025 gross capital-purchase plan from the January guidance. Total purchases rise to USD 14 billion. Wafer-fabrication equipment purchases rise from USD 9 billion to USD 11 billion, while factory construction remains USD 3 billion. The equipment increase is newly approved and was not included in the January plan; no intervening revision was announced. Both releases use the same gross-purchase basis, without offsets for grants or reimbursements. We do not identify equipment suppliers or their revenue schedules.
